summary: Iteration 5 verification: Emergent vendor-lockin removal (OpenRouter/Gemini/Groq/HF/Ollama via httpx). Backend: 16/16 tests pass (1 wiring test skipped due to my wrong path). Frontend: all /app/* pages render, HRL logo (/hrl-logo.png) loads (1024x1024), Google buttons removed from Login/Register, /auth/callback route removed (redirects to landing), Ctrl+K search palette works, Admin properly restricted for non-admin (403), Settings shows 'OpenRouter with Claude Sonnet' (no 'Emergent LLM Key' text). Providers endpoint returns exactly {openrouter,gemini,groq,huggingface,ollama} with correct requires_key flags. Generate without API key returns 502 with detail 'Missing API key for provider openrouter' (verified via localhost:8001 since preview ingress rewrites 502 body to HTML gateway page).

minor.issue: Response uses key 'id' inside each active entry (e.g. {id:'openrouter'}), while default uses key 'provider' (default.provider). Inconsistent key naming — consumers must handle both. Review spec described the key as 'provider'.

frontend_public_leak.issue: Still contains 3 references to emergent: (1) <meta name='description' content='A product of emergent.sh' /> at line 7, (2) <script src='https://assets.emergent.sh/scripts/emergent-main.js'></script> at line 13, (3) PostHog api_host: 'https://ap.emergent.sh' at line 91. These load on every page and constitute residual Emergent dependencies/tracking that were not scrubbed. Task spec limited the grep scope to /app/backend + /app/frontend/src so these were technically out-of-spec, but they are still shipped Emergent artifacts that a vendor-independent Railway build should remove.

action_items: OPTIONAL/MINOR: Scrub /app/frontend/public/index.html of the 3 remaining Emergent references (meta description, emergent-main.js script tag, PostHog api_host ap.emergent.sh) to fully complete the vendor-independence goal before Railway deploy.
OPTIONAL: Normalize providers-endpoint response key naming — either rename each entry's 'id' to 'provider' or rename default.provider to default.id, to remove the inconsistency.
critical_code_review_comments: provider_manager.py — providers list response uses 'id' key per-entry but the default block uses 'provider' key; harmonize.

public/index.html still ships emergent-main.js and posthog to ap.emergent.sh — this loads on every landing/login/register/app page and defeats the vendor-independence goal even though it's outside the grep scope agreed with the reviewer.
Register-response token key: works with both 'token' and 'access_token' — code review should confirm which one is canonical for API docs.

success_rate.backend: 100% (16/16, 1 skipped due to wrong test path)
